sections.Profile:
"Vagabond" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Manufacturing Company in October 1962. Designed by Steve Kordek, it is notable for being the first pinball machine to feature a drop target that completely disappears into the playfield when struck. The game includes two flippers, five pop bumpers, two slingshots, eleven rollover buttons, two kick-out holes, and a single drop target.
